# French OCR data

`fra.traineddata` is from the official Tesseract `tessdata_fast` repository:
https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast/blob/main/fra.traineddata

Downloaded 2026-10-11. Apache-2.0; the bundled `data-LICENSE` covers these trained data.
Recognition runs locally with the existing Tesseract.js runtime.
